_readme: Client-site carousel on /services/website-builds.html (src/components/ClientShowcase.astro). Only entries with live:true render; with none live the section is not rendered at all. Go-live per client: node scripts/showcase-capture.mjs <slug> (shoots the LIVE domain, copies the 'before' shot in), set live:true, build, PR. The build fails if a live entry is missing an image.

clients.name: Edwards Kirby Lawyers
clients.summary: A Sydney insolvency and business law firm on a site that hadn't been touched in years. Rebuilt from the ground up, with a secure client portal alongside it.
